title: World Heritage Sites in Africa
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Facts (to confirm): Kenya's UNESCO sites include Lamu Old Town, Fort Jesus, Mount Kenya, Lake Turkana National Parks, the Kenya Lake System in the Rift Valley, the Sacred Mijikenda Kaya Forests and Thimlich Ohinga.

skills.key_step: The child names World Heritage sites in Africa, says why they are kept and designs measures to conserve them.

floor.question: In which country is Great Zimbabwe?

steps: Say natural or built and why it is listed.

board.say: Is this site natural or built?

board.do: Write a conservation measure for each.

misconceptions.ask: In which country is Lamu Old Town?
misconceptions.repair: Pin Lamu and Stone Town on the coast map.

misconceptions.ask: In which country are the Pyramids of Giza?
misconceptions.repair: Pin the Pyramids in Egypt on the Africa map.
List what a site gives: history, identity, tourism, jobs.

misconceptions.ask: Can a natural place like Mount Kenya be a World Heritage site?
misconceptions.repair: Show Mount Kenya and Lake Turkana on the list.

checks.question: In which country is Lamu Old Town?
Give one reason heritage sites are kept.
checks.answer: any of: culture, history, identity, tourism
